Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing the civil penalty for violating the open public meetings act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to open meetings; amending RCW 42.30.120; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.30.120 and 1985 c 69 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each member of the governing body who attends a meeting of suchgoverning body where action is taken in violation of any provision ofthis chapter applicable to him or her, with knowledge of the fact thatthe meeting is in violation thereof, shall be subject to personalliability in the form of a civil penalty in the amount of one((hundred)) thousand dollars. The civil penalty shall be assessed bya judge of the superior court and an action to enforce this penalty maybe brought by any person. A violation of this chapter does notconstitute a crime and assessment of the civil penalty by a judge shallnot give rise to any disability or legal disadvantage based onconviction of a criminal offense. (2) Any person who prevails against a public agency in any actionin the courts for a violation of this chapter shall be awarded allcosts, including reasonable attorneys' fees, incurred in connection p. 1 HB 2567with such legal action. Pursuant to RCW 4.84.185, any public agency((who)) that prevails in any action in the courts for a violation ofthis chapter may be awarded reasonable expenses and attorneys' feesupon final judgment and written findings by the trial judge that theaction was frivolous and advanced without reasonable cause.
